tools.name: search_listings

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get one published nutrition practice by its slug.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: List countries, regions and cities that have nutrition practices.

tools.description: List categories with their nutrition practice counts.

tools.description: Get the number of published nutrition practices, places and categories, and when the data last changed.
